items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Fine, I'm going to take Pee Wee Russell, I got Freddie Moore, he'll come, I'll take Chippy Hill, how many more?

ctx.x: So here $225 is offered me. And the front all-star
group. Fine, I'm going to take Pee Wee Russell, I got Freddie Moore, he'll come, I'll take Chippy Hill, how many more? That's enough, we'll pick the rest of them in Chicago.

Fine, get to Chicago, okay, give you -- you can have Floyd O'Brien, if you want him. Okay, I want Floyd. Trumpet, give you Lee Collins. Fine, we can't afford no bass, that's it. And we're playing, and it's tremendous. Because we're working opposite either Errol Garner, Sarah Vaughan, we're working opposite those kind of people so the joint is packed.
